subject: Procurement intake: schedule orientation call + MAP & PO checklist
messages:
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
To: dana.lee@acme.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement intake: schedule orientation call + MAP & PO checklist

Hi Dana —

Thanks for the quick intro. I’m Karthik on Redwood’s procurement partnerships team; I’ll be your point for vendor enrollment and PO setup. We’d like to run a short orientation to align on the intake steps so we can get your sandbox and invoice flow set up without surprises.

Quick ask: could you share two 30-minute windows this week for a kickoff? Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 15 Jun, 10:00–10:30
- Tue 15 Jun, 15:00–15:30
- Wed 16 Jun, 11:00–11:30

Agenda (30m):
- Intros & roles (5m)
- Vendor setup checklist: intake form, SSO/KMS notes, security docs (10m)
- PO & invoicing path: our PO template, billing cadence, remittance (7m)
- Mutual Action Plan (MAP) & success criteria (5m)
- Actions & next steps (3m)

Attached: vendor-intake-form.pdf (basic legal/billing fields), redwood-po-template.docx, security-questionnaire.xlsx.

Internal owners: Laura (onboarding ops), Priyom (account lead). Soojin — I’ll loop you in for MAP alignment if needed.

If you’re not the right contact for PO specifics, please point me to whoever owns procurement/finance.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Vendor Enablement | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

[attachment: vendor-intake-form.pdf (1 page)]
[attachment: redwood-po-template.docx (1 file)]

From: Dana Lee <dana.lee@acme.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marco.ruiz@acme.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement intake: schedule orientation call + MAP & PO checklist

Karthik, thanks — and thanks for sharing the docs.

Tue 15 Jun 15:00–15:30 PST works for us. I’ll plan to join along with Marco (IT procurement) — he’ll handle PO/POA questions. A couple quick items for the agenda if possible:
- Clarify net payment terms (Net30 vs Net45) and whether partial invoices are supported.
- Confirm data residency note in the intake form (we need EU-only processing for some workloads).
- Any pre-call info we should complete on the vendor-intake-form?

I attached our standard supplier onboarding checklist (we’ll bring it to the call).

Dana
Dana Lee
Procurement Manager | Acme Robotics
+dana.lee@acme.com

Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com, soojin.lee@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement intake: schedule orientation call + MAP & PO checklist

Perfect — confirmed Tue 15 Jun 15:00–15:30 PST. Meeting invite sent (30m).

Pre-call asks (short):
1) Please fill the vendor-intake-form.pdf where you can (company legal name, remit-to address, AP contact). If you can’t fill everything, we’ll capture during the call.
2) Marco — any standard PO language your AP needs (payee name, remit instructions)? If you have a sample PO we can map to our template, upload to the DocuSign link below before the meeting.
3) Dana — on EU-only processing: we have private deployment options and region routing policies; we’ll cover whether the intended workload needs dedicated tenancy. If you can flag which product features will be in-scope that helps (chat API, embeddings).

I’ve created a short MAP doc for the kickoff so owners/SLAs are clear: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aB-MAP-onboarding-template. The MAP includes milestones: vendor enrollment complete, security questionnaire signed, PO executed, sandbox available, production rollout date. Proposed success criteria: PO signed and first invoice paid within 30 days of enrollment; sandbox ingest validated by Acme security team.

Attachments: redwood-po-template.docx, security-questionnaire.xlsx

Thanks all — Laura will run the checklist during the call; Priyom owns the rollout timeline.

Karthik

[meeting invite: Redwood <> Acme - Procurement Orientation 2027-06-15 15:00 PST]

From: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@acme.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, dana.lee@acme.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com, soojin.lee@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement intake: schedule orientation call + MAP & PO checklist

Thanks for the call earlier — helpful. A few follow-ups from finance/IT: 
- We’ll use Net30. AP needs the full remit-to address and Redwood’s EIN on the PO. I uploaded a sample PO to the DocuSign room (link below).
- For security: we’ll need the completed security-questionnaire.xlsx and the SOC2 report; can you share the latest SOC2 link or upload to the DocuSign room?
- Next steps agreed in the MAP: Redwood to provide sandbox access (Laura), Redwood to return completed security questionnaire and SOC2 (Soojin/Rishi if needed), Acme to issue PO within 7 business days once SOC2 is received.

We’ll track items in our procurement tracker and confirm PO issuance once SOC2/Q is in.

Marco
IT Procurement | Acme Robotics
marco.ruiz@acme.com
